by: tools/sanborn/complete/merge_reads.py: two independent reads, a pick only where they agree within 60 px

west of Colerain the street runs up north-east to Colerain from this angle point (left of the strip)
turns at Colerain Avenue: runs due east on the east side (centre y 6998), west-south-west on the west side

south end at Powers Street (plate edge just below)

notes: Plate's right edge cuts Turrill Street's east side (about x 10400-10430); Turrill centres assume the printed 40 ft width. Chase Avenue lies on the top edge: its north side is off the plate, centre y from the south line (y 140) and the printed 60 ft. 'Palm ?' is a street entering Turrill from the east at y 2455-2600, only the letters PALM are on the plate. The east-west street at y 3300-3400 shows only the word STREET inside this strip; called Blue Rock Street from the plate description. It is 60 ft wide west of Cherry and printed 130 ft east of Cherry (north line steps north about 100 px), so the Cherry crossing centre is a compromise between centre y 3360 (west side) and 3328 (east side). McMakin Street (name printed west of the strip, about x 7950) ends at Delaney from the west and continues east of Delaney as McMakin Alley (12 ft) to Cherry; a second McMakin Alley, offset about 50 px south, runs from Cherry to Turrill. Cherry at Hoffner: one pick at the midpoint of the offset north and south legs. Turrill meets Hoffner only from the south. Powers Street: the east leg (y 7005) and the leg west of Colerain (running south-west, no name printed inside the strip, assumed Powers) meet Colerain at two separate points. Cooper Street's west end at Colerain is crossed by railroad tracks; Colerain centre there is extrapolated from its edges further south. Railroad crossing Cherry/Hoffner diagonally is not a street. | Chase Avenue / Turrill Street: Chase Avenue's north side is cut by the plate's top edge, so y is a guess (south kerb line about y 75-140; sewer manhole at 10285,20); Turrill's centre is x 10350 (40 ft between about 10290 and 10410). Blue Rock Street is about 175 px wide west of Cherry and east of Turrill, but the block lines stand much further apart between Cherry and Turrill (about 3140-3190 on the north, 3510-3560 on the south); the picks there follow the straight centre line between the narrow parts. McMakin: west of Delaney it is printed 'McMAKIN ST.' (narrow, centre y about 3727 at Delaney); east of Delaney it is 'McMAKIN ALLEY' (12 ft), which is offset at Cherry Street (west arm centre y 3783, east arm 3843), recorded as two T-junctions on each. Cherry / Hoffner: railroad tracks cross the junction; the pick is midway between the offset north and south arms. Colerain / Powers: the street on the west side of Colerain (printed only 'ST.', 40 ft) is taken to be Powers Street continuing; pick is midway between the two arms' meeting points with Colerain's centre line (east arm alone would be about 8985,6998; west arm alone about 8955,6932). Cooper / Colerain is on railroad crossing ground, about 10 px less certain. Turrill does not exist between the railroad (y about 4440) and Hoffner Avenue.
